implementation.basis: Independent registration queues, request-scoped hook state, importer/medium cache and committed render-prop publication. Runtime and declarations are independently authored; original tests are retained only in the fixture.
implementation.targetScope: All seven use-sidecar 1.1.3 exports on React 19, including the actual react-remove-scroll 2.7.2 sidecar caller.

changes: Remove tslib and detect-node-es runtime dependencies; React remains a peer.
Cancellation removes one registration in constant time, including duplicate values and NaN; asynchronous writes share a scheduled delivery.
Ignore superseded/unmounted imports and discarded StrictMode effects; cache by importer and medium.
Handle thrown/rejected/malformed imports, render fallback elements and invoke the configured error handler.
Render-prop publication uses a component commit effect instead of calling hooks inside a user render callback; current children closures are preserved.
